# Curriculum fixture

`better-immersion-k5.json` records the unit numbers and character order from pages 1–2 of the Better Immersion New Edition Character List published at:
https://www.pgcps.org/globalassets/schools/elementary/paint-branch/docs---paint-branch/better-immersion-chinese-character-list.pdf

Retrieved October 18, 2026. Copyright Better Chinese LLC (a Better World LTD Company), as marked on the source PDF. This fixture checks the curriculum already present in the recovered app. PDF compatibility radicals were normalized with Unicode NFKC to ordinary Chinese characters (for example ⽜ → 牛). Starter Unit 1 contains basic strokes, not characters, and is excluded. Counts: K 81, Level 1 130, Level 2 151, Level 3 225, Level 4 117, Level 5 135. Grade K has additional supplemental characters outside these unit lists.
